steps.title: Configure App Metadata
steps.description: Establish and verify app-meta.json configuration values for package name consistency.

steps.title: Verify settings.gradle
steps.description: Confirm root module inclusion configurations align with Gradle 8.5.

steps.title: Establish Top-Level build.gradle
steps.description: Verify Google and Maven Central repositories with AGP 8.3.2 configurations.

steps.title: Configure App Module build.gradle
steps.description: Ensure compilation configs target SDK 34, declare native compilation options, and set up source compatibility.

steps.title: Verify Android Manifest Integration
steps.description: Validate AndroidManifest.xml package paths, launchers, and permissions inside valid Android namespace configurations.

steps.title: Review Resource Background Drawables
steps.description: Maintain layout styles, buttons, and input background xml configurations.

steps.title: Augment UI layout with Rotation, Enhancers, Borders and Themes
steps.description: Revise activity_main.xml to incorporate manual input and output rotation buttons, borders control, photo enhancer sliders, and interactive theme widgets.

steps.title: Implement Camera/EXIF Orientation Parsing
steps.description: Write helper methods in MainActivity.java to read EXIF orientation from photo streams to avoid unintended portrait-to-landscape auto-rotations.

steps.title: Develop Interactive Rotate Feature
steps.description: Create logic to rotate the input original photo and the output resized photo dynamically in 90-degree clockwise increments.

steps.title: Build Dynamic App Theme Customizer
steps.description: Add support for four visual styles (Classic Blue, Dark Slate, Forest Green, Royal Purple) with dynamic view updates without restarting the activity.

steps.title: Program Border & Outline Canvas Renderer
steps.description: Develop a precise border painter which overlays solid color borders inside the image bounding box based on user selected color and width inputs.

steps.title: Code the Photo Enhancer Algorithm
steps.description: Integrate brightness offset matrix and contrast scaling factors directly with a ColorMatrixColorFilter in a custom bitmap processor.

steps.title: Integrate Preset Enhancers and Colors
steps.description: Wire up UI controls for Auto-Vibrant auto-settings, Grayscale filters, custom colors, and reset sliders functionality.

steps.title: Building Photo Resizer Pro
steps.description: Execute gradle assembleDebug to build the final stable, upgraded Photo Resizer Pro APK.
